summary: BTC ~$81.8k (-1.2% 24h), holding the $81k area. New overnight: US spot BTC ETFs took in a net $527M on 19 Oct, led by BlackRock's IBIT (+$665M, its biggest day in weeks), which breaks the three-week outflow streak that was last night's main offset. BlackRock also filed for a downside-protected BTC ETF (PBIT) on 19 Oct, and Strategy (+267 BTC) and Strive (+1,223 BTC) disclosed more buying. Retail interest is quieter than institutions. A bit more positive than last night.
